actualNewAxis.textDe: Eigenständiger Transfer an einer zusätzlichen ionisierbaren Restgruppe bleibt Pflicht. Beurteilt werden die selbstständig begründeten Strukturformeln, Protonierungsgleichgewichte und Ladungssummen im neuen Fall. Eine reichhaltige zusammenhängende eigenständige Erklärung kann mehrere Anforderungen zugleich belegen; nach vollständiger Evidenz keine zusätzliche Aufgabe allein wegen einer festen Quote verlangen. Dieses Erklärungsziel verlangt keine Labordurchführung. Elektrophorese bleibt eine gesonderte freiwillige Anwendung und keine zusätzliche Abschlussbedingung dieses Säure-Base-Ziels.
actualNewAxis.textEn: Independent transfer involving another ionisable side-chain group remains required. Assess independently justified structural formulas, protonation equilibria and charge sums in a changed case. One rich coherent independently reasoned explanation may demonstrate several requirements; once the evidence is complete, do not require another task solely to meet a fixed quota. This explanatory goal does not require laboratory execution. Electrophoresis remains a separate optional application, not an additional completion condition of this acid/base goal.

scientificFindings: The new axis explicitly assesses independently justified structural formulas, protonation equilibria and all-group charge sums in a changed case. These are the observable reasoning products required by the unchanged whole acid/base goal; they are not a new practical experiment.

Independent transfer involving an additional ionisable side-chain group remains mandatory. The exact retained lysine case still requires its supplied pKa model, all ionisable groups, dominant net+1 versus predominantly net0 glycine and proton uptake/donation. The meaningful transfer is not removed by resolving the operator ambiguity.

Both languages now state explicitly that the explanatory goal does not require laboratory execution. The previous definite required-actual-execution/color language has been replaced, so it no longer conflicts with the conceptual whole cases. The unchanged generic material-operator axis is conditional on whatever operator a target actually demands; this explicit e9 rule resolves its scope.

Electrophoresis remains a separate optional application, with no additional completion condition for this acid/base target. Correct charge reasoning cannot be replaced by naming an electrode, and the learner need not solve that extra application to complete the stated target.

The no-quota rule now concerns the actual explanatory product: one rich coherent independent explanation can demonstrate several requirements, and complete evidence is not followed by another task solely to meet a fixed number. Fresh meaningful transfer is still required; task labels or repeated statements are not substituted for it.

The exact corrected e9 whole case pair and existing required aspect IDs/coverage/variation rules remain scientifically usable at E1/G1 design level. The supplied pKa values and dominant-form models are not new measurements, and this judgment establishes no learner has demonstrated them.
